name: Winna Hazzard
summary: At Bloodvenom Post, Winna Hazzard studies the blight spreading through Felwood's living things. The Forsaken researcher watches local wildlife and experiments on corrupted creatures, often laughing beside her feline companion.

sections.title: A Peculiar Researcher
sections.body: At Bloodvenom Post, Winna Hazzard studies Felwood's unnatural decay. The Forsaken researcher watches local wildlife and tests tainted water and venomous samples. Her jovial, manic manner can mask callous motives. With liquids drawn from the land, she corrupts the small kitten at her side.

faq.answer: Winna Hazzard studies Felwood's corruption at Bloodvenom Post in north-central Felwood. She asks travelers to gather samples from the wilderness.

When travelers bring Winna a filled flasket of corrupted liquid from the surrounding woods, she feeds it to her kitten. The liquid twists the creature into a Corrupted Cat, and Winna laughs maniacally.

faq.q: What is Winna Hazzard's goal in Felwood?
faq.answer: Winna seeks to understand and harness biological blights. She studies how Felwood's widespread corruption alters living beasts, as many Forsaken apothecaries and scholars do.

angles.text: As Forsaken, Winna pursues corruption with dark eccentricity, reckless curiosity, and little regard for natural harmony.
At Bloodvenom Post, Winna asks passing Horde travelers to gather corrupted reagents for her strange research.
